profile.name: HyunHo Kim
summary: I’m Hyun Ho Kim, a software engineer working across user interfaces, backend services, and AI integrations. Building on my frontend experience, I have implemented web interfaces, MCP servers, and a real-time voice gateway for contact-center services and a B2B AI platform.

I designed and built the frontend, Voice Gateway, and MCP server for the B2B AI platform OptiGen. I separated streamed answers from tool state and implemented audio-based meeting documents with long-running task progress. I established shared components, a design system, and UI tests. Changes to font and chart loading reduced initial data transfer by approximately 54% in the recorded checks.

For the Voice Gateway, I implemented per-call bot configuration, STT/TTS, and provider-specific communication and audio handling. In the NICE PoC, I built repeatable STT evaluation under telephone-audio conditions, numerical normalization, and phonetic correction. ITN rule improvements reduced building and unit-number errors by 18.9% across 1,426 repeated-evaluation transcript observations.

experience.title: LOGOS AI
experience.summary: I designed and built the frontend, Voice Gateway, and MCP server for OptiGen, participated in enterprise AI service proofs of concept, and extended features for customer-specific requirements.

highlights.title: Korea Electric Power Contact Center Advisor
items: I designed and implemented the agent and administrator frontend connecting live STT, post-call AI analysis, and consultation history.
I implemented polling/SSE transitions, transcript recovery, recording synchronization, and multi-tab authentication, and incorporated feedback from the on-site pilot.

In an environment averaging about 50,000 calls a day, 60% of all agents used the service and average customer wait time fell by about 30% after launch. These are operating outcomes for the project as a whole.

highlights.title: OptiGen Frontend
items: I designed and built the administration and user conversation frontend of a B2B AI platform and extended features to meet customer requirements.
I agreed on SSE event rules with the backend to separate answers from tool state and established a design system, Storybook component tests, and PR CI.

Recorded page checks showed approximately 54% less initial data transfer and document-editor CLS falling from 0.225 to 0. I also organized environment-specific deployment settings and migrated server commands from SSH to SSM.

highlights.title: OptiGen MCP Server
items: I designed and implemented an MCP server and tools that accept audio files in OptiGen conversations and return meeting documents and transcripts.

I connected transcription, diarization, and summarization to Markdown and DOCX meeting documents, reducing processing time by 21.8% in a local comparison of the same 95-minute recording with caching disabled.
I separated server instances and connections by session for long-running tasks and delivered execution stages, progress, and final document links in the conversation.

highlights.title: OptiGen Voice Gateway
items: I was responsible for gateway design and implementation connecting PBX/SIP integration, per-call Workers, and multiple Voice AI backends.
I isolated provider protocols and audio formats from shared call handling and made STT/TTS selectable through bot configuration.

For the NICE PoC, I implemented STT evaluation, ITN, and phonetic MCP correction. ITN rule improvements reduced building and unit-number errors by 18.9% across 1,426 transcript observations. In a separate MCP evaluation of 353 missed building numbers, 259 received the correct candidate.
